ai_summary: ## Executive Summary  Aequs Limited's management will participate in the Motilal Oswal 22nd Annual Global Investor Conference on August 17-18, 2026, to engage with analysts and institutional investors. This routine disclosure emphasizes the company's commitment to investor relations and transparency. There are no direct material financial impacts or red flags, as the company explicitly states no Unpublished Price Sensitive Information (UPSI) will be shared during the meetings.
